title: cocode.output (command)
description: Append run output to the run named by run in the Output pane. A run id the window never issued creates an entry named by Claude. done:true closes the run: exit 0 shows ok, anything else failed. Always close the run. Chunks are ordered by seq when present.

stream.description: system lines render dim, e.g. "building first...".

text.description: The chunk. May be empty on the closing message.

exit.description: Exit code, with done:true. 0 is ok, anything else is failed.

ms.description: How long the run took, shown when given.
